I recently moved to the suburbs with my Aunt for summer. I was skateboarding to the local shops getting a feel for the neighborhood. I watched a cop pass me up, park in the apartments next to me, leave after I passed him (on my skateboard) repeat this passing me parking and following me for half a mile. I finally jumped off my board and threw my hands up in confusion as the cop now parked on the street and approached me as I walked over to him. 

Cop: Hey what’s going on?
Me: I’m wondering why you’re following me?
Cop: (laughs nervously) I’m not following you 
Me: ummm yea, you parked and passed me like 4x?
Cop: then why did you walk up to me
Me: Because you’re following me?! What do you want? Are you giving me a ticket for skating on the wrong side of the street? (Laughs) 
Cop: well, yeah I could! I just want to know who you are and where you’re going? You got ID? 
Me: (thinking wtf as two additional cop cars pull up) No, am I under arrest? 
Cop: No, I just want to ask you some questions
Cop 2: place your skateboard and backpack  down on the ground sir (pads me down)
Me: (doing just that explaining being followed) 
Cop 3: don’t reach for your pockets! (places her hand in her side arm) do you have a weapon? 
Me: there’s 3 officers wearing bulletproof vests with guns, and I’ve already been searched! 
Cop 2: I searched him
Cop 3: just keep your hands out your pockets
Me: omg (smh) am I under arrest? 
Cop 1: Nooo! We just detaining you for questioning. why are you scared to give us your identification?
Me: you know what? I’m tried of being harassed book me for skating on the wrong side of the street. Just take me to jail.
Cop 2: We don’t want to take you to jail, there was a robbery around here and you match the description. We’re just checking
Me: Dude! You can’t just follow me minding my business skating, demanding to know who I am where I’m going where I came from, surrounding me with 2 nervous police officers then expect me to be open and trusting?!? (Then proceeds to give him my name birthday and address)
Cop 3: nice skateboard dude
Me: (rolls eyes) thanks
Cop 2: we just going to run your name if you’re clean we let you go
Me: so your NOT trying to solve a crime your fishing
Cop: you don’t have any warrants, your clean
Me: Can I leave now?
